s05-zone-same-moment.note: 1.3/1.4 take the instant and zone sent, which is 1.5.1's clock reading; the moment reading did not exist.

s08-master-start-offpattern.cite: 1.4.0 docs/api-contract.md:136 (1.3.0 :135): without instanceStart, start/end set the series' own first occurrence
s08-master-start-offpattern.note: The start sent (Wed 6 Jan) is realigned to the next Tuesday: the first occurrence lands on 12 Jan, not where it was sent, and 5 Jan is lost while 2 Feb is gained.

s09-master-start-onpattern.cite: main docs/design/series-model.md, Every Kind of Edit, 'Start only' (Today: read as a drag of the first occurrence); main docs/api-contract.md PATCH scope all
s09-master-start-onpattern.note: 1.4 moves every day two weeks and the edited day with them, as its contract says; 1.5.1 moves only the start and asks about the edited day before it.

s10-new-rule.note: Same occurrences as 1.5.1's keep, but 1.4 leaves the edited Tuesday as an override keyed on a day the new rule never produces (series-model cause 9, rule-change-orphans) where keep makes it an event of its own.

s11-count-shorter.cite: main docs/design/series-model.md, Bounds: Start, End and Days Outside; Every Kind of Edit, 'Bound only' (Today: no rule for edited days past a shortened end)
s11-count-shorter.note: Rows only: the edited day past the new COUNT still shows in both, as an override beyond the series' end in 1.4 and as an event of its own in 1.5.1 (outside=keep, preselected).

s12-until-shorter-skip.cite: main docs/design/decisions.md, 'A skip belongs to the occurrence it removed'
s12-until-shorter-skip.note: Rows only: 1.4 keeps a skipped date past the new end; 1.5.1 drops it.

s14-following-rename-edited.note: Same occurrences as give, but 1.4 deletes the edited day's row on the split rather than giving it the title; s15 shows the same deletion losing an own time, which no option of 1.5.1 does.

s15-following-time-edited.cite: 1.4.0 docs/api-contract.md:135-137 (following splits the series; edited occurrences keep their places when a series moves)
s15-following-time-edited.note: The split deletes the edited 2 Feb row: its own 10:00 is lost and it shows at 11:00.

s16-following-skips.cite: main docs/design/decisions.md, '"This and following" and deletes' (UNTIL at the last occurrence before the split, the skips keyed before it kept)
s16-following-skips.note: Rows only: 1.4 writes UNTIL a second before the split day and keeps the 2 Feb skip on the old part too.

s17-following-from-first.cite: 1.4.0 docs/api-contract.md:135 and :144 (following splits the series there)
s17-following-from-first.note: From the first day the old part keeps its DTSTART with an UNTIL before it and still shows 5 Jan, so 5 Jan shows twice (7 events for 6).

s18-delete-following.cite: main docs/design/series-model.md, Every Kind of Edit, 'Delete following' (skips from the day on dropped)
s18-delete-following.note: Rows only: 1.4 keeps the 2 Feb skip past the new end.

s19-delete-following-first.note: Delete following from the first day leaves the series with an UNTIL before its start, still showing 5 Jan; nothing of 'this and following' should remain.

s22-attendance-this.cite: 1.4.0 docs/api-contract.md:412 (POST /undo undoes the most recent create, update or delete)
s22-attendance-this.note: Rows only: Undo of the answer leaves the override row it created, with attendance none; what shows is restored.

s23-attendance-following.note: The split deletes the edited 2 Feb (its own title lost). Undo also takes two presses: the split and the answer are separate journal entries, and POST /undo undoes one (1.4 :412), so one Undo leaves the series split with the edited day gone; 1.5.1 makes it one entry (decision, main api-contract /attendance).

s26-relationship-following.note: The split deletes the edited 2 Feb (its own title lost).

s27-relationship-all.cite: 1.4.0 docs/api-contract.md:144 by analogy (attendance all sets the master and every override); :143 does not say
s27-relationship-all.note: On a mine calendar 'maybe' for all events leaves the edited day confirmed while every other day is tentative; /attendance all in the same version reaches the edited day (s24).

s29-calendar-following.cite: 1.4.0 docs/api-contract.md:135 (following splits the series and the new part lives on the target)
s29-calendar-following.note: The split deletes the edited 2 Feb (its own title lost).

s31-calendar-all-from-edited.cite: 1.4.0 docs/api-contract.md:135 (an override patched with calendarId detaches); main docs/api-contract.md PATCH (scope all from an edited day moves the whole series)
s31-calendar-all-from-edited.note: 1.4 does what its contract says: the edited day leaves the series for the other calendar.

s32-rejoin.note: Rows only: 1.4 has no 'use series value'; the closest request (the series' title with scope this) keeps an override row equal to the series.

s38-drag-from-edited-row.cite: main docs/design/series-model.md, Every Kind of Edit, last row (#189; Today: the day's own row changes alone)

s39-weekly-list-member.note: 1.4 shifts the whole pattern (Tue, Thu, Sat); 1.5.1 preselects moving only the Wednesdays.

s40-weekly-list-week.note: 1.4 shifts the whole pattern a week; 1.5.1 preselects moving only the Mondays a week.

s41-biweekly-list.cite: 1.4.0 docs/api-contract.md:136 (the series changes by the same number of days; a weekly BYDAY shifts with it)
s41-biweekly-list.note: Days crossing the week start land in the off weeks (Mon 18 Jan for Mon 11 Jan), matching neither 1.5.1 reading (series-model table, cause 4).

s42-monthly-setpos.note: Rule kept (second Tuesday), start snapped to 13 Jan: the first day moves, every other day stays.

s43-monthly-15-to-30.note: BYMONTHDAY=15 kept with the start on 30 Jan: only the first day moves.

s44-monthly-weekday-set.note: Rule kept, start on Sat 2 Jan, a day outside the rule that still shows; the drag ignored for every other month.

s45-monthly-last-day.note: Rule kept, start on 30 Jan outside it: 30 and 31 Jan both show, February's day stays on the 28th.

s48-yearly-feb29.note: Rule kept, start on 1 Mar 2027 outside it: 2027's event moves to 1 Mar and 2028's stays on 28 Feb.

s53-following-tags-people.cite: 1.4.0 docs/api-contract.md:135 (following splits the series); no line lets a split drop content
s53-following-tags-people.note: The new part has no tags and no people.

s54-following-count.note: 1.4 takes the COUNT sent as the new part's (7 events in all); 1.5.1 preselects the series' whole count (5).

s55-time-and-day-from-own-time-day.cite: main docs/design/decisions.md, 'A drag is measured against the occurrence as it shows' and 'Changing every event from an edited day'
s55-time-and-day-from-own-time-day.note: 1.4 measures the drag from the day's key (one day and two hours) and leaves the edited day on its own Tuesday; 1.5.1 measures from where it shows and adopts its time.
